{"consolidated_memory":"CONSOLIDATED MEMORY: Broken Layout in notifications/email/render.py (Three Separate Incidents)

Component: notifications/email/render.py (notifications side)
Problem: Broken layout in the email renderer manifesting as a table overflow in the plain text part of email rendering
Reproduction: Render the digest template with a long subject
Stack/Tests: Python; tests/notifications/test_render.py

---

INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-08]
Trigger: Only occurred for records carrying non-ASCII names
Root Cause: A listener registered but never removed
Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and added an assertion in a test
PR Details: PR #2176 on branch fix/broken-layout-3
Outcome: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 74 days running

---

INCIDENT 2 [2026-05-02]
Trigger: Only occurred when the input list came in empty
Root Cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR Details: PR #7268 on branch fix/broken-layout-6
Outcome: 5 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

---

INCIDENT 3 [2026-05-07]
Trigger: Only occurred for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
Root Cause: Off-by-one error in the slice bound
Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
PR Details: PR #7564 on branch fix/broken-layout-7
Outcome: Alert stayed quiet for 81 consecutive days"}
